landing.section_agents_subtitle: Not generic chatbots — purpose-built agents that understand your codebase, infrastructure, and business context.
landing.agent_architect_role: Code review, architecture design, performance audits, API design
landing.agent_developer_role: Full-stack development, features, bug fixes, refactoring
landing.agent_designer_role: UI/UX design, Figma integration, design systems, brand assets
landing.agent_coo_role: Task coordination, sprints, finance, product management, prioritization
landing.agent_devsecops_role: Docker, deployment, monitoring, backups, security audits, DNS
landing.agent_tester_role: Unit tests, E2E tests, smoke tests, health checks, coverage
landing.agent_trader_role: Market analysis, backtesting strategies, portfolio monitoring
landing.agent_smm_role: Content creation, social media, YouTube series, cross-posting
landing.agent_cat_role: Controlled chaos experiments — breaks things so the team learns to fix them
landing.agent_ai_role: Agent optimization, smart model routing, prompt injection scanning, memory management
landing.section_memory_subtitle: Not a chatbot with a context window. A multi-layer memory system where every session, decision, and lesson compounds into permanent agent knowledge.
landing.memory_feature_layers_desc: L0 (identity) → L1 (rules) → L1.5 (feedback) → L2 (semantic search) → L3 (cold archive). Each layer has a different retrieval speed. Agents load the fast layers automatically and query L2 on demand — no cold starts.
landing.memory_feature_ingest_desc: Every night at 04:45 UTC, 5 ingesters run in sequence: Claude Code sessions, AI chat history, coaching transcripts, Telegram conversations, and completed VS tasks. Nothing gets lost. Agents wake up smarter every morning.
landing.memory_feature_wiki_desc: Each agent builds its own structured wiki — not a RAG index, but compiled knowledge. Strategy, templates, analytics, brand voice. RAG re-derives from raw docs each query. The wiki accumulates. Every session makes the agent sharper.
landing.memory_feature_search_desc: Dense vector search (pgvector, 768-dim nomic embeddings) + lexical BM25 fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Find the right context even when the query is vague. 1600+ memories across 4 wings and 9 rooms, growing daily.
landing.memory_feature_meta_desc: The AI Agent (Ай) monitors the whole system: scans for prompt injection attempts, routes trivial tasks to the local gemma4 model instead of Claude, and auto-consolidates memory when MEMORY.md fills up. The system improves itself.
landing.memory_feature_secure_desc: Secrets scrubber is fail-closed — ingest stops if a token slips through. age-encrypted backups go to NAS nightly. Weekly restore drills run automatically. If the drill fails, Telegram alert fires. No silent backup rot.
landing.section_karpathy_subtitle: We apply Andrej Karpathy's coding principles as a behavioral layer for every agent. Four rules that prevent the most common LLM coding mistakes before they happen.
landing.section_karpathy_meta: Adapted from the work of Andrej Karpathy —
landing.section_karpathy_wiki_note: This is the second level of Karpathy integration in Vibe Studio. The first is the Karpathy Pattern — each agent maintains a structured domain wiki as working memory between MemPalace and active rules. Both layers compound: better process + accumulated knowledge.
landing.karpathy_p1_desc: Never assume the task is clear. Agents surface tradeoffs, identify ambiguities, and ask when uncertain — before writing a single line.
landing.karpathy_p2_desc: Minimum code that solves the problem. No speculative abstractions, no future-proofing that isn't needed today.
landing.karpathy_p3_desc: Touch only what must be touched. No reformatting nearby code, no renaming on a whim. Every diff is intentional.
landing.karpathy_p4_desc: Define verifiable success before starting. Maps directly to our acceptance criteria and verificationCommand — tasks aren't done until runtime confirms it.
landing.section_why_subtitle: Not another project management tool. A system where AI agents actually build and ship software.
landing.why_specialized_desc: 10 agents with distinct roles, tools, and domain knowledge. An architect reviews code differently than a tester runs tests.
landing.why_production_desc: 6 real projects running 24/7 — dashboards, SaaS, trading bots, monitoring. Not demos, not prototypes.
landing.why_memory_desc: MemPalace gives agents long-term context. They remember past decisions, recurring bugs, and your preferences across sessions.
landing.why_autonomous_desc: Parallel agents in isolated git worktrees. Acceptance criteria with runtime verification. Tasks flow from idea to deployed code.
landing.why_transparent_desc: Client portal with task tracking, milestone updates, and Q&A. Clients see exactly what's happening and when.
landing.why_infra_desc: Runs on your own infrastructure. Secrets in Infisical, backups encrypted with age, weekly restore drills.
landing.section_infra_subtitle: Production infrastructure managed by AI agents — with proper secrets handling, real-time monitoring, and automated recovery.
landing.infra_secrets_desc: Zero plaintext secrets in code or config. Self-hosted Infisical generates .env files via agent on each host. MCP servers access secrets through wrapper scripts with host-specific paths. Timing-safe comparison for all token validation.
landing.infra_monitoring_desc: Custom Go service tracks 15+ Docker containers, Cloudflare tunnel, PostgreSQL, Redis, Telegram bots, and backup health. Auto-healer restarts crashed services. Public dashboard at status.example.com — updated every minute.
landing.infra_security_desc: UFW + Fail2ban on host. Every API endpoint requires auth — no exceptions. DOMPurify on all HTML rendering. Prompt injection scanner checks context files. Nightly architecture + security reviews by Architect agent.
landing.infra_backup_desc: Daily pg_dump of all databases, age-encrypted, synced to NAS. Weekly automated restore drills — decrypt, restore to throwaway DB, verify row counts, drop. Telegram alert on any failure. 30-day on-host / 90-day NAS retention.
landing.section_workflow_title: From Idea to Production in 5 Steps
landing.section_workflow_subtitle: Submit an idea. AI agents plan, build, test, and deploy — with full transparency at every step.
landing.workflow_step1_desc: Describe what you need in plain language. The system creates an initiative and asks clarifying questions.
landing.workflow_step2_desc: COO agent breaks the idea into tasks with dependencies, assigns agents, sets acceptance criteria.
landing.workflow_step3_desc: Developer, Architect, Designer work in parallel git worktrees. Each agent commits to its own branch.
landing.workflow_step4_desc: Automated tests, E2E checks, security review. Tasks require runtime verification to be marked done.
landing.workflow_step5_desc: Merged to main, built on server, deployed. SMM agent posts the update. MemPalace remembers everything.
landing.section_portal_subtitle: A dedicated portal where clients track tasks, answer agent questions, and approve work — without touching code or Jira.
landing.portal_feature_dashboard: Real-time dashboard with task progress, completion %, and activity feed
landing.portal_feature_questions: AI agents ask clarifying questions — clients answer directly in the portal
landing.portal_feature_approval: Task approval workflow — clients review and sign off on completed work
landing.portal_feature_timeline: Auto-generated project timeline with milestones and releases
landing.section_compare_subtitle: Not a replacement for developers — a force multiplier.
landing.section_youtube_subtitle: Every day, the agents ship something. Every day, we record it. Watch the journey from Day 1.
landing.founder_quote: Started as 1 developer. Grew into 11 AI agents. All running in production.
